recipes.name: Asparagus and Mozzarella Stuffed Chicken Breasts
ingredients_raw: 2 large skinless, boneless chicken breast halves
salt and black pepper to taste

steps.text: Gather the ingredients. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Grease an 8-inch square baking dish.

Place each chicken breast between two sheets of heavy plastic (resealable freezer bags work well) on a solid, level surface. Firmly pound chicken with the smooth side of a meat mallet to an even thickness of about 1/4 inch. Sprinkle each side with salt and pepper.
Place four asparagus spears down the center of each chicken breast, then top with mozzarella. Roll chicken around fillings to make tidy, compact rolls.
Transfer chicken, seam-side down, to the prepared baking dish. Brush chicken breasts with mayonnaise if using and sprinkle bread crumbs over top.

Bake in the preheated oven until no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, about 25 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).

raw_recipe.headline: Asparagus and Mozzarella Stuffed Chicken Breasts
raw_recipe.description: Asparagus stuffed chicken breasts with mozzarella cheese are lightly breaded, cooked to perfection, and on the table in less than an hour.

video.description: In this video, you'll see how to jazz up plain chicken breasts with the addition of fresh asparagus, creamy mozzarella and a crunchy coating. It may sound complicated, but trust us, it's a whole lot easier than you think!

review.reviewBody: After reading the other comments about dryness, I rolled the asparagus and cheese in the chicken. Then spread a thin layer of fat free mayo over the chicken and rolled it in panko crumbs. It stayed moist and looked beautiful.

My husband and I loved this. He is an extremely picky eater and raved about how good it was. I followed recipe as stated except, I used Italian bread crumbs that also had Parmesan cheese in it and used cheddar cheese cause that was all I had on hand. I also only used 2 asparagus stalks per breast because that’s all I had. Next time I will make sure to have more asparagus. My husband said it would have been even better that way. Oh I did use the mayo on the chicken before breadcrumbs. It keeps the chicken nice and juicy. I also used my air fryer option on my Ninja Foodi XL. It was done in 25 minutes. Great recipe. Thanks for sharing.

If you watch the video first, they do suggest spreading 2 tablespoons of mayonnaise over each breast before adding the breadcrumbs. That will help to combat any dryness and give you a pretty golden brown color. Will be my chicken dish for next week.🤗

I started out planning to make the Chicken Cordon Bleu II, but changed midstream when I discovered some Asparagus that I had purchased and not used yet. So from here, I followed the recipe to the letter as far as most ingredients go, but I didn't have bread crumbs, and since I'm on a Keto Diet, substituted some other spices. 
The dish is an "A" dish, hands down. 
I did augment it slightly out of necessity. I used three (3) boneless breasts, pounding them to 1/4" thickness, as prescribed. I purchased a Martha Stewart Meat Hammer for this and this was my first chance to use it. The results were better than expected. I preheated the oven to 375 degrees, waiting for the temperature to reach that heat before inserting the food. That's an important aspect, as it determines the accuracy of the timing. I've heard others above suggest that the chicken was dry, causing me to wonder if they over-cooked the meat. The chicken is so sensitive to heat.
To ameliorate the meat flavoring, I used a chicken rub/spice, Herbs de Provence, Kosher Salt, and Coarse Black Pepper. the only other twist was to use slightly more Mozzarella Cheese. I'm sure that these additions amp up the carbs but the Cheese excites your metabolism and increases weight loss. I topped the breasts with Best Foods Mayonaise as indicated and the outcome was special. 
While I didn't take a picture, I cooked Mac and Cheese with three kinds of cheese, and sweet small kernel corn. The meal was a hit

I was making one serving of this for the man, so used half a chicken breast (sliced widthwise), pounded thin. I used half goat cheese half gruyere and rubbed with a thin layer of basil pesto before stuffing with parboiled asparagus. Topped with a bit more pesto and Italian Panko, 25 min was perfect. Great week night meal.

This had a good flavor and was pretty simple to make, not much prep time either. I didn't have asparagus so I used fresh baby spinach instead. I also used a different type of cheese, something with a stronger flavor. I added garlic powder and Italian seasoning too. I followed the video suggestion to top with mayo to keep chicken moist then sprinkled breadcrumbs. The only negative is it took 35 mins to fully cook instead of 25 but that's certainly not a deal breaker. Hubby liked it too so I will make this again in the future, but with asparagus. I really like how versatile this recipe is.

Wow! Super yummy! 
Instead of using a couple of tablespoons of mayonnaise as suggested in the video, I cut back on the pepper I added to the chicken breast and mixed some lemon pepper with about a cup of mayonnaise to cover the top of the chicken breasts. Then I sprinkled them with the breadcrumbs and baked them covered for about 25 minutes and uncovered for another 10 minutes. So moist and juicy! My husband requested that I make this again sometime very soon.

This recipe was fantastic and easy to prepare. I did make some changes to spice it up. like others I added garlic and red peppers with asparagus and to ensure not to dry out the chicken try adding cream of asparagus soup on top after cooking for 20 min. cover dish with foil after adding soup and bake for another 10 min. you wont be disappointed.

First of all, this is a great recipe! I was a bit confused by the photos, video, and list of ingredients. They did not seem to match. They were difficult to follow. So I kind of meshed them all together and made it my own. Here is what I did. I took two chicken breast, cut them in half, and pounded them out. I salt and peppered them and also added Italian seasoning. I placed mozzarella cheese and asparagus on them and then rolled them up. I wrapped a piece of bacon around each bundle, topped with mayo, and Italian breadcrumbs. I baked at 375 for about an hour. It was great! I served it with salad, bread and pasta.

This recipe was very easy to make. I used 1 large chicken breast and cut it horizontal in half to serve 2 in my household. I didn't have italian bread crums, just plain, so I added italian seasoning to my plain panko bread crumbs and it turned out great. The asparagus was not cooked as much as I like, so I think I'll cook it some first next time. I served it with chicken low sodium rice-a-roni and added some asparagus the last 15 minutes of cooking and it also turned out great and paired perfectly with the chicken. I defiantly will make this again.

Super simple to make. Some reviewers mentioned dryness so rather than change the ingredients, I parcooked the asparagus first for about 3 minutes in the microwave then reduced the cooking time of the chicken once assembled to 18-20 minutes. I also greased my cooking pan with olive oil then drizzled a little over the chicken breasts. The breasts I used were smaller so juices ran clear at 18 and I had four asparagus spears per breast. I'll be making this again, thanks!
So easy and delicious! Will definitely make again. The world’s pickiest eater (husband) LOVED IT!

I read the reviews before making this, so I added a few things. I added Adam's "Buttery House" (HEB for those in TX) on the inside, a little garlic powder on the top & after I put the breadcrumbs on, I added a tiny bit of Italian seasonings. When it was nearly ready, I added more cheese on top. It was fabulous! Don't be afraid to use your favorite seasonings!!
Yummy

Great base recipe! I stuff it with more like 6-7 spears per piece. Have used all different kinds of cheese, from goat cheese to cheddar Brushing the “rolls” with flavored aioli is my secret trick to add more flavor, and instead of breadcrumbs, you might want to crush some Ritz crackers or seasoned croutons

Very bland. Good recipe for a fitness/weight loss nutrition program but I need more flavor in my food. Some of the comments have good suggestions which I plan to try in the future. Not sure if this is a keeper or not. Needed to cook longer, btw or at higher temp. I broiled the breasts for several minutes to get a better crust on top.
Great recipe- easy to make and delicious! We loved it. Chicken breasts were too thick to pound so had to slice in half lengthwise and it worked. Served with side of quinoa. So good!
My husband and I are empty nesters, we don’t like making fussy meals! lol! This is super easy and delicious and perfect for two! Thanks for sharing!
Yummy

This is a great base recipe. It stands alone very well, but with a few weeks has another flavorful taste (great for creativity!). I mixed a few different herbs or spices over time. I also did the mayo/crumbs addition as stated by others. I chopped fresh mushrooms also. This is a versatile favorite!
